definitions.short: properly, to hack , i.e. engrave (Judges 5:14, to be a scribe simply); by implication, to enact (laws being cut in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (gen.) prescribe
definitions.usage: appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.
definitions.full: H2710. chaqaq [ חָקַק ] verb cut in, inscribe, decree (Late Hebrew id. , Aramaic חֲקַק , Zinjirli חקק ; Phoenician id. Participle Hiph`il; Arabic be just, right, obligatory , also make or decide to be just , etc.; justness, truth, necessity, obligation ; Ethiopic adjective moderate, sufficient ; compare also חקה ) — Qal וְחַקּוֺתָ֫ Ezek 4:1 ; suffix חַקֹּתִיךְ Isa 49:16 ; Infinitive suffix בְּחֻקּוֺ Prov 8:27 ; בְּחוּקוֺ 8:29 (assimilated to בְּשׂוּמוֺ ); חֻקָּהּ Isa 30:8 ; Participle חֹקְקִי 22:16 (archaic case ending Ges § 90 . 3 a); plural חֹקְקִים 10:1 ; construct חוֺקְקֵי Judg 5:9 (possibly Po`el = מחוקקי with מְ omitted, see Ges § 52 (2), note 6); Participle Pass. plural חֲקֻקִֿים Ezek 23:14 (Co חקוקים ); — 1 cut in , with בְּ , Isa 22:16 , of a dwelling-place = tomb, in a rock. 2 cut in or on, upon, engrave, inscribe , with על on roll of a book Isa 30:8 ; representation of city on brick (as in Babylonia) Ezek 4:1 ; images on a wall 23:14 ; figurative of Zion's walls on palms of ׳י Isa 49:16 . 3 trace, mark out , a circle, with על over the face of deep Prov 8:27 ; with accusative, foundations of earth 8:29 . 4 of a law , engrave, inscribe (on a tablet), figurative for enact, decree און חקקי חקקים Isa 10:1 (|| עמל כתב ); ישׂראל חוֺקקֵי poetic = commanders (see Po`el ) Judg 5:9 (|| מחקקים 5:14 ). Po`el Imperfect יְחוֺקְקוּ Prov 8:15 ; Participle מְחֹקֵק Gen 49:10 ; Num 21:18 ; Deut 33:21 ; suffix מְחֹקְקִי Psa 60:9 ; 108:9 ; מְחֹקְקֵנוּ Isa 33:22 ; plural מְחֹקְקִים Judg 5:14 ; — inscribe (as a law), enact (poetry): with accusative צֶדֶק Prov 8:15 elsewhere participle a. prescriber of laws, hence (as sovereign authority in a warlike clan) commander Deut 33:21 (of warlike tribe of Gad), Judg 5:14 ; Isa 33:22 (of ׳י ; || מַלְכֵּנוּ שֹׁפְטֵנוּ, ). b. commander's staff Gen 49:10 (|| שֵׁבֶט ), Num 21:18 (both poetry), Psa 60:9 = 108:9 . Pu`al Participle מְחֻקָּק that which is decreed Prov 31:5 (late). Hoph`al Imperfect יֻחָ֑קֿוּ Job 19:23 inscribed in ( בְּ ) a book.
